name: Get Leads by Program ID
summary: Pulls all leads that are members of a specific program, including each lead's membership details (status, how they were acquired, success reached).
whenToUse: When you want to see who's in a program and their progression status. Find the program ID from the program's URL in Marketo.

path.name: programId
path.label: Program ID
path.hint: The numeric ID of the program (visible in the Marketo UI URL when you open the program).

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Pick which lead fields to include (the 'membership' details are always included).

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Lead records, each with a 'membership' object: progressionStatus, acquiredBy, reachedSuccess, membershipDate (plus stream/cadence for engagement programs).

notes: Membership details come back on every record even if you don't request them.
